document.title: Add cigster eval cases and review existing expects
document.summary: Eval cases can now ship a `repo.bundle` so the runner never clones the repo, and three cigster cases use it. The commit-label check ignores a dropped final period, and comprehende-39 now expects the `gitCommonDir` move instead of the `gitEnv` caller.
document.why: Máté asked for graded eval cases from three private cigster PRs that the public Eval suite can run, and for a pass over the cases that failed on main ([request](source:s1)).

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 23
sources.gist: Add cigster-84, cigster-99, and cigster-118 as foreign graded cases that run in CI without GitHub auth, and review comprehende-39 and comprehende-47 after main run 35823530539.

lookFor: The request asks for private cigster cases that run in the public Eval suite without a token. Each case bundles its own git objects, so `eval.yml` is unchanged ([request](source:s1)).
The request names two main failures. comprehende-47 was the harness being too strict, and comprehende-39 had an `apart` pair that contradicts the skill ([request](source:s1)).

parts.name: Bundled cases
parts.summary: A case can carry a shallow git bundle, and three cigster cases use one.

parts.name: Expect review
parts.summary: The commit-label check and the comprehende-39 expects now follow the skill.

groups.title: Bundle a case's git history
groups.why: cigster is private, and CI clears `GH_TOKEN` before the producer runs, so an anonymous clone fails ([request](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `writeCaseBundle` cuts history at `base` into `repo.bundle`, and `cloneCaseBundle` rebuilds a shallow bare repo from it with `base` as the boundary.
lookFor: Subtle: a bundle has no shallow list, so `cloneCaseBundle` writes `base` to `shallow` before the fetch. Without that line, the fetch fails its connectivity check on the parents of `base`.
`writeCaseBundle` refuses a `base` that is not an ancestor of `head`, because the cut at `base` would drop the merge base.

groups.title: Write and read bundles
groups.why: Uses the bundle helpers from the add-case command and from the runner.
groups.summary: `eval:add --bundle` writes `repo.bundle` next to `case.json`, and `runEval` opens that bundle in the temp dir instead of the shared clone cache.
lookFor: When a case has `repo.bundle`, the runner skips `ensureBareClone` and `fetchCaseRefs`, so a stale bundle never falls back to the network.

groups.title: cigster-84, cigster-99, and cigster-118
groups.why: Adds foreign cases from a different repo shape: test fixtures, a large mixed e2e PR, and an analytics feature ([request](source:s1)).
groups.summary: Frozen PR, issue, and comment sources, each with a `repo.bundle` of about 6.5 MB and an `expect` that follows the skill's grouping and lookFor rules.
lookFor: cigster-99 omits the `why` expect, because its PR names two stories under one ticket.
Each `claims` entry is a mismatch between a source and the diff, such as the stale `E2E_UI` note in PR #99. Claims do not fail a case.

groups.title: Commit label without the final period
groups.why: comprehende-47 failed on main because the producer labeled a commit with its subject minus the final period ([request](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `commitSourceFailures` compares subjects through `subjectKey`, which trims whitespace and trailing periods on both sides.
lookFor: A shorter prefix such as `Replace tickets` still fails. Only trailing periods and whitespace are ignored.

groups.title: comprehende-39 expects the gitCommonDir move
groups.why: comprehende-39 failed on main with apart 0/1, but `skill-sync.ts` only adopts the new `gitEnv` helper, so grouping it with `exec.ts` is correct ([request](source:s1)).
groups.summary: The case now expects `repo.ts` and `lfs.ts` together and `exec.ts` apart from `lfs.ts`, and the case test no longer requires every case to expect `why` present with no `together`.
lookFor: Two producer runs put `skill-sync.ts` with `exec.ts` and in its own call-site group, and both follow the skill. Both runs kept the `gitCommonDir` move in one group.

commits.subject: Pin comprehende-39 to the gitCommonDir move instead of the gitEnv caller.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Two runs split skill-sync.ts both ways and both groupings follow the skill. Both runs keep the repo.ts and lfs.ts move together and apart from exec.ts.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Add cigster-84, cigster-99, and cigster-118 eval cases with frozen bundles.
commits.author: Cursor Agent

commits.subject: Expect exec.ts and skill-sync.ts together on comprehende-39.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
skill-sync.ts only adopts the new gitEnv helper, so the old apart pair contradicted the review concern. Drop the case test that pinned every case to why present and no together.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
